description: Print user and group information for each specified USER, or (when USER omitted) for the current user.

option.name: --context
tip: print only the security context of the process (not enabled)

option.name: --group
tip: Display only the effective group ID as a number

option.name: --groups
tip: Display only the different group IDs as white-space separated numbers, in no particular order

option.name: --ignore
tip: ignore, for compatibility with other versions

option.name: --name
tip: Display the name of the user or group ID for the -G, -g and -u options instead of the number. If any of the ID numbers cannot be mapped into names, the number will be displayed as usual

option.name: --real
tip: Display the real ID for the -G, -g and -u options instead of the effective ID

option.name: --user
tip: Display only the effective user ID as a number

option.name: --zero
tip: delimit entries with NUL characters, not whitespace; not permitted in default format

option.name: -A
tip: Display the process audit user ID and other process audit properties, which requires privilege (not available on Linux)

option.name: -p
tip: Make the output human-readable. Each display is on a separate line

option.name: -P
tip: Display the id as a password file entry
